caption: The drawing consists of a single object that resembles a dagger or ceremonial blade centered on a plain, beige background. The blade is rendered in grayscale pencil or ink, with a pointed, triangular, metallic-looking blade at the bottom. The hilt is ornate, symmetrically designed, and features intricate detailing with a zigzag or serrated pattern running along both sides, as well as rounded shapes and a central vertical column. The object appears to be metallic, with shading used to highlight its form and give it a three-dimensional appearance. Below the blade, slightly to the right, is the signed name "Syd Roberts" in small, capitalized letters. There are no other objects or elements in the drawing, and the background is untextured and evenly colored.
title: Button Hole Cutter
